experiment.run_order: Serial runs, seed outer loop. Rotate/reverse workload order by seed. Alternate participant and policy order by seed and workload. Full four-run seed/workload set replaced if compiler activity occurs during any run.
experiment.build_command: PYTHONPATH=. CCACHE=1 scons -j8 release=1 client_profile=full server=0
experiment.host_contention_guard: Wait for no clang before run; poll once/second during run. Preserve/retry whole seed/workload set if clang appears. Other host activity not controlled.

validation.supplemental_long_pilot: Seed42, 65536ticks, both policies/participant counts; same-policy final checksums match; excluded from aggregate estimates.

metrics: Chronological native-u64 per-tick wall durations in nanoseconds. Tick-to-tick change is absolute difference between consecutive durations; mean and p99 reported separately. Cluster is a maximal consecutive run of at least two ticks exceeding 1ms (also5ms and33.333333ms recorded); count per million executed ticks. Rolling8/32-tick windows sum consecutive durations. CPU is all-process CPU, normalized per1000 executed ticks; memory is /usr/bin/time -l peakRSS. Aggregate estimates give each of32seeds equal weight. Per-game quantiles use floor((n-1)*p).
queue_delay: Extra staging-boundary advances beyond first eligible admission boundary. Excludes ordinary request-to-next-boundary latency and fixed eight-tick publication delay. Includes only requests ultimately admitted; stale/canceled/legacy synchronous-overflow requests excluded from delay distribution. Actual overflow counts separately retained, and all CPU costs included. Per-game histogram bins0-4095 plus exact maximum; no observed histogram saturation. P95 values are averages of per-game quantiles.
statistics: 10000 paired seed bootstrap resamples, NumPy default_rng seed20261016. Percentile95% intervals for change in arithmetic means. Exploratory comparisons, no multiple-comparison correction. Largest-case results include all32seeds for both modes/participant counts. Late-half comparison restricts to matched seed pairs with all16384samples for ticks16384-32767. All32archipelago and large-map pairs qualify; small duels generally end sooner.
host_contention: Serial benchmark runs. Gate on no active clang before run; poll for compiler work once/second during runs. Replace entire four-run seed/map set if any run overlaps compiler activity; all excluded attempts/reasons retained. Initial interrupted runner resumed safely; incomplete or flagged sets replaced wholesale. User asked to wait for other builds and later confirmed they had finished; final large-map matrix resumed thereafter. Other OS/background activity is not controlled.
build: Same optimized release executable as policy experiment (binary SHA in experiment.json), AppleClang -O3, no dev_fast/PCH/unity; source snapshots and prior matching build log included. Frozen engine base43b153739838207983c922ab4cbeed7773459de9. No source changes for expanded matrix.
behavior: Cold gradients still initialize synchronously; eight-tick background publication and lazy depth policy unchanged. Four-per-team quota is separately enforced for every team, unused quota not borrowed. All finite policies retain >64-request synchronous-overflow fallback. No output saves, autosaves, checksums, detailed event logging, or replay recording in timed runs. End-of-run world checksum retained.
limits: Single AppleM3 Mac, three fixed shipped maps, fixed AI lineup per map; vary only game seed within workload. One compute participant reduces parallelism, not core speed/memory bandwidth/power/thermal characteristics. Headless unrestricted execution excludes rendering and real-time pacing. Policies change game development, so measured CPU includes different evolving worlds; not isolated scheduler overhead on identical later work. Legacy overflow fallback can affect the workload, particularly on eleven-team map. PR1197 queued cold-initialization demand not included. Private benchmark prototype, not production/save/network compatibility validation.
commands: Exact command/environment/binary hash/RSS/load averages and exit status retained in every run.json. Driver and analysis scripts included. Analysis uses uv run --offline --with matplotlib==3.10.7 python artifacts/gradient-admission-variety-20261016/analyze.py; runtime versions retained in analysis-runtime.json.
